a3plus/review.quote: The delegate requested a time-bound review; the Council adopted a continuous review with a consensus-based working group to review twice-yearly reports.
a3plus/review.reason: The source expresses an intention to review continuously. The appended sentence says the Council adopted continuous review, which can be read as a substantive commitment beyond the stated intention.

malta/review.quote: The Council decided to review the Focal Point's mandate and reports, while Malta proposed using the Focal Point to gather information for sanctions committees.
malta/review.reason: The supplied resolution expresses an intention to review continuously and creates a working group that examines reports. The sentence says the Council decided to review the mandate and reports, which blurs the force and the assigned actor.

malta/authority.reason: The 42-word draft exceeds the cap. It also invents Malta's specific recommendation element, which the delivered explanation does not mention.

a3plus/review.quote: The African members and Guyana preferred a time-bound review; the Council adopted a continuous review with a consensus-based working group to review twice-yearly reports.
a3plus/review.reason: The sentence preserves the speaker's full group attribution and time-bound preference. Saying the Council adopted continuous review can be read as a new commitment where the provision expresses an intention.

a3plus/authority.quote: The African members and Guyana preferred a time-bound review for full implementation, but the Council adopted a confidential report with no recommendation, leaving delisting decisions to the committee's normal procedures.
a3plus/authority.reason: The two claims about a preferred time-bound review and committee procedure are reported separately. The delivered authority provision does not establish a substantive comparison about review timing.

switzerland/review.quote: The Council adopted a working group to review the Focal Point, aligning with Switzerland's view of the mechanism as an ideal model and progress.
switzerland/review.reason: Switzerland called the separate 1267 Ombudsperson the ideal model. The draft transfers that assessment to the mechanism being reviewed by the newly established working group.

switzerland/authority.quote: The Council assigned the Focal Point a confidential report without a recommendation, differing from Switzerland's preference for an ideal model with recommendations. The Committee decides delisting under normal procedures.
switzerland/authority.reason: The supplied Swiss statement calls the Ombudsperson an ideal model and welcomes the stronger Focal Point. It does not attribute to Switzerland a preference for an ideal model with recommendations.

malta/review.prefix: On 19 July 2024, the Council unanimously adopted draft S/2024/557 as resolution 2744, with all 15 voting in favour. The resolution replaced the 1730 delisting procedure and directed sanctions committees other than the 1267 Committee to revise their guidelines. It requested that the Secretary-General appoint a new Focal Point within three months, in consultation with the working group. Malta said the Focal Point would engage with petitioners and gather information from several sources for a report to assist sanctions committees in their deliberations and decisions. The Council expressed its intention to review the Focal Point’s mandate and work continuously. It established a consensus-based working group whose functions include reviewing the Focal Point’s twice-yearly reports.
